trial.method: Pack both clean source revisions; install their exact archives in an isolated offline npm consumer with empty HOME and cache, disabled scripts, closed stdin, bounded commands, and an unreachable registry.

limits: This isolates the source-owned exact version pin; it does not test successor Provider v2 behavior.
The work-lane package has an unreleased version label and is identified only by its source commit and archive digest.
No ETHOS semantic, static, interactive, human, rollback, acceptance, or release parity is established.
